Author: E. Ann Carson, Ph.D., BJS Statistician
Table 3. Percent of state prisoner deaths, by cause of death, 2001 and 2008–2018

Note: Data may have been revised from previously published statistics. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. Excludes executions. For execution data, see Capital Punishment, 2017: Selected Findings (NCJ 253060, BJS, July 2019). See Methodology. Includes deaths in private state facilities.
a/Includes persons who died of illness and were identified as HIV-positive or having AIDS at the time of death.
b/Includes other specified illnesses (such as cerebrovascular disease, influenza, and other nonleading natural causes of death) and unspecified illnesses.
c/Includes homicides committed by other prisoners, incidental to the use of force by staff, or resulting from injuries sustained prior to incarceration.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Mortality in Correctional Institutions, 2001 and 2008–2018.
